parameters.name: PrivateIpAddress
parameters.description:
Specifies whether to obtain the kubeconfig file that is used to connect to the cluster over the internal network. Valid values:

*   `true`: obtains the kubeconfig file that is used to connect to the master instance over the internal network.
*   `false`: obtains the kubeconfig file that is used to connect to the master instance over the Internet.

Default value: `false`

example.unifiedCli: aliyun adcp describe-hub-cluster-kubeconfig --cluster-id c102fe5f1ee5d4c87a68121a77d8b0000 --private-ip-address false --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun adcp DescribeHubClusterKubeconfig --region cn-hangzhou --PrivateIpAddress false --ClusterId c102fe5f1ee5d4c87a68121a77d8b0000
